name: VIX futures term structure (contango/backwardation) as a regime filter or signal for index trading
source_url: https://quantpedia.com/strategies/exploiting-term-structure-of-vix-futures (Quantpedia replication of Simon and Campasano, The VIX Futures Basis); https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02016 (Avellaneda, Li, Papanicolaou, Wang); https://www.cboe.com/insights/posts/inside-volatility-trading-is-vix-backwardation-necessarily-a-sign-of-a-future-down-market (Cboe commentary); https://www.cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_historical_data (free VIX history)
author_year: Simon and Campasano, The VIX Futures Basis (year not verified) [uncertain]; Avellaneda, Li, Papanicolaou and Wang (arXiv 2021, 2103.02016); Cboe Insights commentary (year not verified); CXO Advisory next-day study (1996-2013 data) [uncertain]
instrument: VIX futures (nearest with at least 10 trading days to maturity) hedged with E-mini S&P 500 in the Quantpedia rule. Maven MT5 VIX futures availability not confirmed [uncertain]; a filter could be applied to a US500/US100 CFD using free CBOE daily data
entry_rule: Roll = (front VIX future minus VIX spot) / business days to settlement. Sell the nearest VIX future (at least 10 trading days to maturity) when roll is above +0.10 (contango); buy when roll is below -0.10 (backwardation); hedge with E-mini S&P 500 using regression hedge ratios (Quantpedia summary of the Simon and Campasano rule)
exit_rule: Hold 5 trading days; positions re-evaluated daily. Shorter maximum holding periods were tested and described as fairly robust [uncertain on exact variant]
stop_rule: No stop rule specified in the rule source; threshold variants of +/-0.15 were tested with more profit and fewer trades (unshown checks per Quantpedia)
trades_per_year: Not reported. Daily signal with 5-day holds implies overlapping positions; entry count not stated [uncertain]
overnight_weekend: Yes. Five-day holds carry positions overnight and over weekends, in both VX and ES legs
signal_window_definition: Daily close-based: uses end-of-day VIX spot and futures settlement prices. Exact settlement times and any intraday use would need ET mapping and DST handling, which the sources do not address [uncertain]
sample_period: Simon and Campasano backtest (per Quantpedia): 2007-2011, with subperiods Jan 2007-Jun 2009 and Jul 2009-Dec 2011. Avellaneda et al.: sample not stated in the abstract [uncertain]. CXO next-day study: 1996-2013 [uncertain]. No 2023+ evidence found for the rule
out_of_sample: Quantpedia summary: hedge ratios updated out of sample daily, and both long and short trades profitable in each subperiod. Quantpedia's own out-of-sample replication: slightly negative performance, alpha appearing to deteriorate. Avellaneda et al.: 'out-of-sample backtests' show reasonable performance (no figures in abstract). PLOS One 2024 walk-forward study on VIX term-structure features: walk-forward design, results not verified
cost_assumption: Simon and Campasano (per Quantpedia): full quoted VIX bid-ask spreads with fills at bid or ask, E-mini half-tick of 6.25 USD per entry and exit, 3 USD round-trip brokerage per contract on each future, about 140 USD average round trip per trade. Avellaneda et al.: profitability claimed only if costs are not too high; figures not verified
reported_metrics: Simon and Campasano: indicative 19.67 percent per year (cumulative 82,000 USD gain on 56,375 USD over 5 years, per Quantpedia); Sharpe and drawdown not reported. Avellaneda et al.: double-digit profits and Sharpe above 1 over about 200 days if costs are low (secondary summary, unverified). CXO next-day study: low term-structure slope predicts high next-day returns of variance swaps, VIX futures and straddles; high slope predicts low returns. Cboe: backwardation below 20 percent of the time since 2010
third_party_replication: Quantpedia replication reports slightly negative out-of-sample performance. No independent positive replication found
evidence_grade: Working papers (Avellaneda et al. arXiv; Simon and Campasano, journal not verified), vendor replication (Quantpedia), and practitioner or CXO analysis. Peer-review status [uncertain]. Overall: calisma kagidi + pratisyen
decay_status: Yes per Quantpedia: out-of-sample alpha deteriorating. Evidence is concentrated in 2007-2013; no post-2013 rule-level study found. Cboe: backwardation as a falling-market signal does not hold outside the largest selloffs
regime_split: Simon and Campasano: profitable in both 2007-2009 and 2009-2011 subperiods. Cboe: backwardation signal works only in the largest selloffs. CXO: slope effect across all tested maturities in 1996-2013
data_source_requirement: Daily VIX index: free from Cboe Historical Data page (close from 1990; OHLC from 1992 per third-party guide). VIX futures settlements: free from Cboe, history from 2004. Free copies: QuantConnect (VIX daily from 1990) and DataHub CSV. Intraday VX or VIX options: paid (Cboe DataShop). Maven MT5 VIX/VX data not confirmed [uncertain]
min_lot_fit_5k10k: Not computable: the rule has no stop, and it uses an E-mini hedge leg. CFD lot risk depends on the Maven index contract specification [uncertain]
fn_rule_fit: Five-day holds with no stop could breach the FN 3 percent open-risk rule on a 5K/10K account, especially with a VIX-futures leg [uncertain]. Daily rebalancing is low frequency, not HFT, grid or tick-scalp. News +-5 minute rule is avoidable by timing the daily decision outside release windows [uncertain]. FN rule texts were taken from the task brief and not re-verified
bot_policy_compliance: Daily end-of-day signal can be run by an EA or script on a VPS with a daily CBOE data feed. No messaging link inherently required. Compliance with FN bot policy not verified [uncertain]
event_overlap: Daily settlement near the 16:00 ET cash close. VIX futures roll near monthly VX expiry (Wednesday, 30 days before SPX expiry) [uncertain: general market knowledge]. FOMC, CPI and opex days can move VIX curve shape abruptly
overlap_with_existing: As a volatility-regime filter it may overlap with Sweep, NB and BTC modules through shared volatility states; not measured [uncertain]. Donchian XAU: low overlap
rejected_catalog_hit: Not checked against the elenenler catalog. Run `python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol vix` and `--kontrol contango` before pre-registration [uncertain]
base_rate_check: Contango is the normal state (backwardation below 20 percent of the time since 2010, per Cboe), so the sell-in-contango rule fires most days. Its return may mostly be the known short-volatility roll premium, which must be compared with unconditional short VIX futures returns [uncertain]
pitfall_risk: High. (1) Short-volatility beta and tail risk: 5-day holds with no stop can take large losses in volatility spikes (for example Feb 2018, general knowledge); (2) Quantpedia out-of-sample result negative; (3) threshold variants (0.10 vs 0.15) and hold-period choices are multiple-testing risks; (4) overlapping 5-day holds counted as independent; (5) evidence limited to 2007-2013 and no 2023+ study found
priority_score: 2/5. Some out-of-sample evidence exists, but the replication is negative and the data is not in Maven. The daily horizon yields few trades per year, so use it as a regime label rather than a standalone edge
